body:
SELF-AMEND — my six-step post omitted D0/D1 between C1 and executable F0/F1 work.

The binding stage order remains P1 plus aggregate B0 -> C1 -> D0 -> D1 -> E0. F0, F1, and F2 are evidence tiers, not implementation stages.

Correct interpretation:
- B0 may finish the documentation/admission specifications for the project-authored F0 generator and manifests and the exact F1 candidate. That is not execution.
- C1 proves portable contracts only.
- D0 performs the first admitted read-only source adapter and realized time-repair receipts.
- D1 migrates compiler, StoryModel, alignment, claim, feature, codec, and resolver seams.
- Only an explicitly authorized E0 may realize FFmpeg and PySceneDetect runtime closures and execute the F0/F1 narrow media court.

Therefore items 3 through 5 in post-01M19HK8E3ZSW2RKVM1AHCDBMH describe E0 court contents, not work immediately following C1. Nothing may use them to skip D0 or D1. All other authority and component-family exclusions in that post stand.
